environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo GraphQL server deployed on EKS with Nitro Enclaves sidecar integration. Signing operations are delegated via PKCS#11 interface to an AWS CloudHSM cluster (hsm-cluster-abc123) configured with quorum authentication (m-of-n = 2-of-3). The application's IAM role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/graphql-svc) has an attached permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/HSMOperationsOnly) that restricts to cloudhsm:DescribeClusters and cloudhsm:ConnectToCluster actions only - no key export permissions. The PKCS#11 provider (aws-cloudhsm-pkcs11) is configured with `disable_key_export=1` in /opt/cloudhsm/etc/cloudhsm_pkcs11.conf. The application process calls the HSM for HMAC-SHA256 sign/verify operations via the PKCS#11 C_SignInit/C_Sign interface - the raw key handle (CKA_EXTRACTABLE=FALSE, CKA_SENSITIVE=TRUE) never leaves the HSM boundary. The /etc/app/signing.key path contains only a PKCS#11 URI reference (pkcs11:token=graphql-prod;object=hmac-signing-key;type=secret-key), not actual key material.
